g.text: Regional priorities depend on rate and volume
Customer destination | one row per delivered order | full dataset period
Source: Olist orders and customers. Up to 10 destinations are shown in each ranking; all 27 remain in the exports. n = eligible delivered orders.
Dashed line = overall 6.77%. Small samples make rates sensitive to a few orders.
